meta.title: Enterprise Task & Productivity Platform
meta.description: Corporate task management, compliance, and personal productivity in one workspace.

footer.tagline: Unified workspace for tasks and compliance

auth.loginDescription: Enterprise task platform — sign in with your corporate account
auth.errorMissing: Please enter your email and password.
auth.errorSession: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.footerNote: Accounts are provisioned by an administrator only.

integrations.title: Secure integration vault
integrations.subtitle: Secrets are stored with AES-256-GCM and never shown again. Only tools enabled for your account by administrators appear here. Decryption runs on the server only when you run the assistant after approval.
integrations.noToolsStaff: No connection tools are enabled for your account. Please contact your administrator to activate the required integrations.
integrations.noToolsSuper: No connection tools are enabled for this account. You can activate Odoo and email from AI tool governance.
integrations.formMissingOdoo: Could not find the Odoo form.
integrations.formMissingEmail: Could not find the mail form.
integrations.footerNote: Keep CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY secret in your hosting environment (e.g. Netlify) and never commit it to source control.

notices.odoo: Odoo credentials saved securely (password stored encrypted).
notices.odoo_clear: Odoo credentials removed from the vault.
notices.email_clear: Mail settings removed from the vault.

errors.odoo_fields: Complete the Odoo URL and login name.
errors.odoo_password: Odoo password is required on first save.
errors.odoo_encrypt: Encryption failed: verify CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server.
errors.email_fields: Complete mail server fields and usernames.
errors.email_imap_password: IMAP password is required on first save.
errors.email_smtp_password: SMTP password is required on first save.
errors.no_license_odoo: You are not licensed for the Odoo tool — ask a super administrator to assign it in AI tool governance.
errors.no_license_email: You are not licensed for the email tool — ask a super administrator to assign it in AI tool governance.

odoo.title: Odoo
odoo.desc: Server URL, database (optional), login and password — only encrypted values are stored.
odoo.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret

email.title: Email IMAP / SMTP
email.desc: Receive and send servers with TLS by default. Leave password fields blank on update to keep existing encrypted secrets.

documentsPage.title: Company documents
documentsPage.subtitle: Track expiry dates with structured compliance indicators (on track, due soon, overdue) and export to Excel using the same rules.
documentsPage.emptyDescription: Add company documents with expiry dates to enable alerts and executive reporting.
documentsPage.dialogNewDescription: Enter document details, expiry date, and alert window in days.
documentsPage.dialogEditDescription: Update fields, then save your changes.

documents.alertRange: Alert days must be between 0 and 730

users.emailNameRequired: Email and full name are required
users.membershipRequired: Select at least one company and role
users.roleLookupFailed: Could not resolve the role for the selected company
users.cannotDeleteSuperAdmin: Super administrator accounts cannot be deleted

chat.sameCompanyOnly: You can only message colleagues in the same company

aiGovernance.unknownTool: This tool is not registered in the system.

executiveDashboard.title: Performance at a glance
executiveDashboard.subtitle: Figures respect your permissions: super administrators see all companies; staff see only their companies (RLS).
executiveDashboard.taskDistributionDesc: Completed, in progress, overdue — within your scope
executiveDashboard.taskDistributionEmpty: No tasks in the current scope.
executiveDashboard.docsByTenantDesc: Count of expired or alert-window documents per company
executiveDashboard.docsByTenantEmpty: No documents in scope or all are outside the alert window.

tasksPage.title: Corporate tasks
tasksPage.subtitle: Automatic days and months remaining, colour cues by due date and daily follow-up.
tasksPage.emptyDescription: Try changing the company filter or create a new task to start tracking.
tasksPage.followUpToast: Follow-up recorded — manager and super admin were notified
tasksPage.dialogSubtitle: Days and months remaining are calculated automatically from the due date.

tenantsPage.title: Companies
tenantsPage.subtitle: Add and edit companies with bulk actions.
tenantsPage.confirmBulkDelete: Selected companies and all related data will be deleted. Continue?
tenantsPage.slugHint: The slug uses lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens only.

usersPage.title: Users
usersPage.subtitle: Invite staff, link companies and roles, and run bulk actions.
usersPage.confirmBulkDelete: Selected accounts will be permanently removed. Continue?
usersPage.inviteDescriptionBefore: Accounts are created with default password
usersPage.inviteDescriptionAfter: and must change it on first sign-in. Link the employee to at least one company.

profilePage.title: Profile
profilePage.intro: Update your name and contact details. To change your password, use the password update flow when prompted at sign-in.
profilePage.cardAvatarDesc: JPEG / PNG / WebP — up to 2 MB
profilePage.cardIntegrationsDesc: Credentials are encrypted on the server before storage.
profilePage.namePlaceholder: Name as shown in the system
profilePage.nationalIdHint: To change the national ID, contact your administrator.

remindersPage.title: Personal reminders
remindersPage.subtitle: Independent of corporate tasks. Checked every 45 seconds while the app is open, with sound, in-app and email alerts when fired.
remindersPage.emptyDescription: Create your first reminder to stay organised outside corporate tasks.
remindersPage.dialogSubtitle: Pick date and time in your device timezone; stored as UTC on the server.

aiGovernancePage.title: AI tool governance
aiGovernancePage.loadUsersError: Could not load the user list.
aiGovernancePage.lead: Control registered tools (Odoo, mail, and future modules) per user. Staff only see integrations you enable for them under “System connections”.

aiGovernanceClient.footerNote: Changes save immediately. Staff only see integrations you enable for them under “System connections”.

integrationsActions.activityEmailDeleted: Mail settings removed from the vault.
integrationsActions.testOdooNoLicense: You are not licensed to use the Odoo tool.
integrationsActions.testOdooPasswordHint: Enter your Odoo password to test, or save settings first.
integrationsActions.testOdooDecryptFail: Could not decrypt the stored password (check the server key).
integrationsActions.testOdooSuccess: Odoo test succeeded: authenticated via XML-RPC without fetching data.
integrationsActions.testEmailNoLicense: You are not licensed to use the mail tool.
integrationsActions.testImapPasswordHint: Enter the IMAP password to test or save settings first.
integrationsActions.testSmtpPasswordHint: Enter the SMTP password to test or save settings first.

dashboardAnalytics.pieDesc: Completed / overdue / waiting — within your permission scope
dashboardAnalytics.pieNoData: Not enough data to show the chart yet.

chatPage.title: Communication hub
chatPage.subtitle: Instant text chat with colleagues. The voice call button previews a future provider integration.

chatClient.aiAssistantCardHint: Ask about tasks, documents, and execution proposals
chatClient.membersSubtitle: Chat with colleagues or the AI assistant (your company context and licensed tools).
chatClient.noColleagues: No colleagues to show within your company scope.
chatClient.threadDescAi: Streaming replies from the server — real execution always goes through proposal approval.
chatClient.placeholderAi: Ask about tasks, documents, or request an action…
chatClient.voiceDescription: Planned feature: WebRTC or a provider such as LiveKit for secure calls between members.

proposalReview.bodyRequiredToast: Message body is required before sending.
proposalReview.dialogSubtitle: Draft reply — edit the text or subject, then confirm send via SMTP from the server.

aiAgentPending.panelSubtitle: Review details in the dialog, then confirm execution — nothing runs before “Confirm execution”.
aiAgentPending.emptyDescription: When you run a scan, analyse text, or chat with the assistant, proposals appear here for review before any execution.

aiAgentPage.heroLead: It reads, analyses, and prepares actions; nothing is executed without your explicit approval. Secrets are decrypted on the server only when needed to reach Odoo or mail.
aiAgentPage.bannerNoTools: No AI tools are enabled for your account — ask your administrator in AI tool governance.
aiAgentPage.bannerVaultNeeded: Licensed tools: {tools}. Add vault credentials from System connections to enable scanning and execution.
aiAgentPage.bannerReady: You can run “Source scan” for enabled tools ({tools}) after configuring the vault (OPENAI_API_KEY required for proposals). Execution happens from the server only after your approval.
aiAgentPage.okAnalysis: A new proposal was added to the pending inbox.
aiAgentPage.okExecuted: Your approval was processed and the action executed (or status recorded) successfully.
aiAgentPage.okRejected: The proposal was rejected and logged.
aiAgentPage.errLlm: Could not reach the model or parse the response. Check OPENAI_API_KEY.
aiAgentPage.errInsert: Could not save the proposal to the database.
aiAgentPage.errNotPending: This proposal is no longer pending.
aiAgentPage.analyzeTitle: Analyse text and create a proposal
aiAgentPage.analyzeDesc: Paste a message, meeting note, or any text — analysed on the server (OpenAI when the key exists, otherwise a local fallback).
aiAgentPage.textPlaceholder: Example: the client asked for a follow-up task until 2026-05-10 titled contract review…
aiAgentPage.logSubtitle: All events linked to the assistant and vault for this account.

aiAgentScan.cardDesc: Calls only tools registered in the system and licensed for your account ({tools}), then passes results to OpenAI. Runs on the server (suitable for Netlify); errors are logged and shown as toasts.
aiAgentScan.hintNoTools: No tools are enabled for your account — ask your administrator in AI tool governance, then connect the vault for licensed tools.
aiAgentScan.hintTiming: A scan may take tens of seconds. Ensure OPENAI_API_KEY is set for automatic proposals.
aiAgentScan.overlayScanning: Connecting to sources and analysing content on the server…

aiAgentError.toast: Something went wrong in the assistant workspace.
aiAgentError.title: Could not load the assistant workspace

aiAgentActions.proposalNotFound: Proposal not found or not allowed.
aiAgentActions.proposalNotPending: This proposal is no longer pending.
aiAgentActions.rejectFailed: Could not reject (the proposal may have changed).
aiAgentActions.scanNoTools: No tools are enabled for your account — an administrator assigns tools in AI governance.
aiAgentActions.scanNoModelOutput: The model produced no proposals from scan data (check permissions or content).
aiAgentActions.scanNoOpenAiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set — scan was not analysed automatically.
aiAgentActions.logScanComplete: Source scan complete: Odoo {taskCount} tasks, {emailCount} unread emails → {inserted} new proposals.
aiAgentActions.scanDoneSummary: Scan done: {taskCount} Odoo tasks, {emailCount} unread emails, {inserted} new proposals.
